description.raw: When a battle starts, Lorsan links the nearest and farthest enemy heroes to each other with Stormbound Chain. The chain transfers 70% + 10% (SP-based) of the damage taken by one of the linked enemies to the other. Damage transferred by the chain cannot exceed 500% of Lorsan's ATK and will not defeat the enemy. The chain breaks when its total damage dealt to both enemies reaches 900% of Lorsan's initial ATK, or if one of the linked enemies is defeated.
